title: Releasing: from merged PR to signed artifact

content.summary: A merged PR reaches a signed artifact with no hand-made tag: release-please opens the release PR, and merging it cuts the tag.

sections.h: `commit-search-depth` limits how far release-please looks back

blocks.text: release-please walks main back from the head and stops after `commit-search-depth` commits, 200 here. A component whose last tag is further back is not seen.
